verdicts.reason: A reads well left to right (logo, bottle, headline/body, CTA) and its text is readable. However, it is cramped: the bottle nearly touches the top and bottom edges, the oversized CTA crowds the right and bottom edges and competes with the headline, and the stacked circles butt against 'fizz'. B has a tiny, weak SOLSTICE logo and body copy too small to read at this size, with an orphaned 'sweet.' line. Its bottle is jammed against the top and bottom edges, and a big empty middle leaves the elements scattered, so it is the worse of the two.
